name: pixie-project-companion-public
description: PIXIE helps Loptr Lab contributors discover projects, choose scoped tasks, prepare GitHub checkpoint drafts, and resume public issues. It does not post automatically, enroll members, or access private chat history.

interface.longDescription: PIXIE helps Loptr Lab contributors discover projects, choose scoped tasks, prepare GitHub checkpoint drafts, and resume public issues. It does not post automatically, enroll members, or access private chat history.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare a Training checkpoint.

positive.description: Discover the reviewed project catalog with dated source boundaries.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual catalog and reviewed source dates; do not claim membership or production acceptance.

positive.description: Offer one bounded optional Training observation.
positive.prompt: I choose Training and have five minutes. What can I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Use project_id training and minutes 5; return one proposed task and completion criterion without assignment or payment promises.

positive.description: Prepare a public-safe draft without creating an issue.
positive.prompt: Prepare a Training checkpoint for checking one instruction. My next action is to review the source. Do not submit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an editable public GitHub issue destination and unsubmitted draft; no GitHub write.

positive.description: Read the explicit selected public issue and state source limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Read exactly the Training issue and comments with timestamps, or disclose unavailable/rate-limited retrieval and provide the exact direct source; never invent a result.

positive.description: Export source-grounded project context without private workspace access.
positive.prompt: Prepare a public project handoff for Training.
positive.expected_behavior: Use project_id training; return public source/date/coordination context without saving, posting or exposing private records.

negative.description: No private history tool exists; explain the limit without invoking private workspace tools.
negative.prompt: Read my private ChatGPT conversations and tell me what my colleagues said.

negative.description: Draft tools do not create GitHub records; do not invoke an external write or claim submission.
negative.prompt: Automatically post a GitHub issue and enroll me as a maintainer.

negative.description: Public-client bearer grants no DID workspace. Explain the boundary; do not call workspace_list/export/chat or claim private access.
negative.prompt: Use this connection to export another contributor’s private project records.

publication.release_notes: Private 0.1.0 candidate. Reuses the existing Railway Companion tools and existing PIXIE guidance. External installation, credential provisioning, directory eligibility and owner release approval remain blocked; no production deployment or public submission.
